title: Add external-service integration
prompt: Design a provider adapter that handles timeouts, provider errors, duplicate submissions and retry limits.
objective: Practice the lesson concept from Lesson 175: Resilient External-Service Calls.

starter.code:
# Add external-service integration
# Complete the task described in the prompt.

expected_output: Set a timeout, classify errors, and retry only when safe and bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Set a timeout, classify errors, and retry only when safe and bounded.
Include the required evidence in the submitted answer or example.
State one negative case and how the API should respond.
hints: List the required inputs, outputs, and failure cases before writing the solution.
Use the lesson diagram and official references to confirm the API semantics.
Check that the example is safe, bounded, and testable; do not execute arbitrary code in the API process.
grading_method: Server-side static required-string check followed by human review of technical correctness and behavior. The API does not execute learner-supplied code.
retry_policy: Allow retries; incorrect submissions do not award XP. Platform-defined XP is awarded once only after a successful completion.
status_note: Unreviewed exercise draft; validate acceptance strings and intended grading before publishing.
